subject: Request: short grace top-up for expired pilot credits
messages:
From: Megan Ortiz <megan@cloudsentry.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Diaz <chris.diaz@cloudsentry.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial ended — quick ask for a short grace top-up

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the PoC ran well but we hit our account limit yesterday and the trial expired before we could finish the final throughput test. Procurement is waiting on the performance run to sign the SOW.

Could Redwood extend a small, temporary credit (around $500 worth) or re-enable the sandbox for 72 hours so we can complete the last validation? We can send the SOW and approvals immediately after. I attached a screenshot of the usage spike that exhausted the credits.

Appreciate any short-term help — timing is tight on our side.

Best,
Megan Ortiz
Head of AI, CloudSentry
megan@cloudsentry.io

Attachment: pilot-usage-20270419.png (screenshot)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Hi Megan — thanks for flagging this and for the screenshot. Really glad the PoC is close.

Looping in Ben (sales ops) and Lauren (manager) to assess whether we can grant a short credit top-up for the final validation run. If we can, we’ll aim for a 72-hour sandbox re-enable and a $500 promo credit as you suggested.

Ben — can you check account limits and confirm if a 72-hour re-enable + $500 one-off credit is ok under current promo policy? If Finance needs anything from CloudSentry, please advise.

Megan — could you confirm the exact test window you need (dates/times) so we can schedule the re-enable? Also we received the draft SOW you mentioned? If you can attach it that speeds procurement.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0192

Tessa — checked the account. CloudSentry is on a self-serve pilot; ops can do a one-time, non-recurring credit for evaluation under the Manager approval threshold.

Proposal: 72-hour sandbox re-enable + $500 credit applied to the account (internal promo code: GRACE-72-7081). This preserves a single-event approval and keeps audit trail tidy. No legal sign-off needed for this amount; Finance okayed centrally under promotional budget.

Lauren — please confirm and I’ll queue the credit and send the DocuSign link for the SOW once CloudSentry confirms dates.

Ben Carter
